original_poem:
کشمیر، کی چھٕ پوٚست آفِس  
راتی گٕلٕوٚن گٕچھٕ؟  
چھٕس یٲتٕھ ہند کھیسِت پٲٹھ  
اور موسمٕ آوٚن چھٕنٕ۔

میہٕ ژٔند ہٕندٕ ٹُھریٚ  
ہر پتھر چھٕ یِک زٲندَک  
ہند گھرانی چھٕں ٹُرٕن دیٔندٕ  
بچٕو چھٕں ہنوز وٛچھیٚن۔

مٕنٕس کی زٲند زِندٕرٕ  
جہاں خاموشی راستۂ سٕرۂِ  
جہاں سورج سُنٛن نہ کرن  
اور سایے بےخبر پھلٕن۔
translated_poem:
Kashmir, is there a post office,  
For letters arriving at dusk?  
We are waiting to be told the history of snow  
And learn the names of seasons.

My world is in fragments,  
Each shard reflects a life,  
Of families torn by the wind,  
Of children who still wait to be found.

Let me speak to you of the valley,  
Where silence moves through the streets,  
Where the sun sets without a sound,  
And shadows fall unnoticed.

stanzas.loss_note: The Kashmiri phrase 'یٲتٕھ ہند کھیسِت پٲٹھ' literally evokes waiting in the manner of one who has lost track of time under snow — the translation 'history of snow' flattens this into abstraction, losing the embodied, conflict-era sense of snow as enforced stillness and collective amnesia.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: severed channel of communication between the displaced and their homeland
the forgetting of cyclical time under prolonged displacement and conflict

stanzas.loss_note: The Kashmiri 'سایے بےخبر پھلٕن' carries the specific resonance of shadows spreading without witness — in Kashmiri conflict poetry, 'shadow' (saya) often implies the presence of the disappeared or the unacknowledged dead; 'fall unnoticed' partially preserves this but loses the ghostly, unwitnessed-death connotation.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: silence as the only inhabitant moving through streets emptied by conflict
the sun's setting as an indifferent witness to unacknowledged suffering
the unwitnessed spread of the disappeared across the valley's memory

cultural_entities.translation_note: Kashmir here is not merely a geographic name but the locus of a specific post-1989 political and humanitarian crisis; the translation preserves the name but not the weight of that historical specificity.
